systems.owner: Agence Nationale d'Identification des Personnes (ANIP), under the President of the Republic
systems.tiers: National; ANIP is represented by departmental delegations at the prefectures (DDIP) and, at commune level, by a communal unit at the town hall (UCIP), under the decree of 6 June 2018
Commune-level registers whose design, implementation, security and management the decree gives to ANIP, a national agency; the decree does not say commune staff work in them

note: A decree organising the national identification agency. The town hall appears only as the seat of the agency's communal unit; nothing is stated about commune offices being connected. A law places nothing.
